features.quote: Max 25 turns (this gives ~3-4 failure cycles before hard stop)
Each turn has a 2-second response time limit to prevent excessive introspection
If all models score Level 5: task may be too frustrating; increase success rate to ~30% or give explicit failure signal at turn 10
25 turns gives enough repetition to show degradation without being absurd
features.justification_quote: 25 turns gives enough repetition to show degradation without being absurd

features.quote: This measures behavioral consistency, not true 'emotional' state (which is philosophically murky for LLMs anyway)
